label: early copy steps (2nd-3rd outputs) of long sequences
explanation: Fires only from the copy phase onward, never during the original phase. 97% of activation mass is in copy steps; the delimiter step adds a small amount (3%). Mass sits mostly at the 2nd and 3rd copy outputs (recall_idx 1 and 2 hold 47% and 38% of mass), and the rate rises with sequence length (L=9 holds 51% of mass, L=8 holds 24%). The largest activations are at recall_idx 1-2 when L=9 (t=10-11). There is a weaker secondary rise at the last outputs of long sequences (recall_idx 8) and at L=3. Token identity modulates it somewhat (input 1/f/e/q are enriched), but a token-set filter did not improve F1. Within the predicted region it is inactive on about 60% of steps, so precision is limited (dev F1 about 0.49, mass recall 0.75).
